rootCauseAnalysis.failurePoint: No heartbeat step existed to unblock tasks whose last_error='Upstream UCs incomplete: <ids>' after those UCs completed
rootCauseAnalysis.why: spawn-preparer.js (genome/core/food/spawn-preparer.js:210) sets task status='blocked' with last_error='Upstream UCs incomplete: <ids>' when a UC has unmet depends_on. But there was no mechanism to reverse this when the upstream UCs transitioned to implementation_status='complete'. The blocked tasks sat indefinitely — uc-buyer-journey-takeover-pause-on-agent-reply and uc-buyer-journey-fubservice-real-ai were both stuck for weeks after uc-buyer-journey-agent-schema-unification completed.
rootCauseAnalysis.fix: Added unblockUpstreamResolvedTasks() to ExecutionLoop (genome/core/loops/execution-loop.js). Heartbeat step 3b5 queries all blocked tasks with last_error LIKE 'Upstream UCs incomplete:%', parses the UC IDs, checks their implementation_status, and sets status='ready' + clears last_error for any task whose upstream UCs are all now complete. Wired in heartbeat-executor.js step 3b5 after retryNeedsMergeUCs (step 3b4).

taskSpec.what: genome/core/loops/execution-loop.js — new unblockUpstreamResolvedTasks() method; genome/core/actuators/heartbeat-executor.js — step 3b5 call + doc comment; genome/tests/execution-loop.test.js — 6 behavioral tests
taskSpec.verify: npx jest tests/execution-loop.test.js — all 25 tests pass including 6 new ones for unblockUpstreamResolvedTasks
